source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (eviction OR evictions OR "forced eviction") AND (housing OR tenants OR tenant OR rental OR landlord OR landlords OR urban OR city OR slum)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(eviction OR evictions OR "forced eviction") AND (housing OR tenants OR tenant OR rental OR landlord OR landlords OR urban OR city OR slum),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("forced eviction" OR "eviction" OR "evictions") AND ("city" OR "housing" OR "landlord" OR "landlords" OR "rental" OR "slum" OR "tenant" OR "tenants" OR "urban"))
